web_title_d.text: Customer · Web · Support, sign-in, legal, errors

web_note_booking.text: Booking flow is ONE artboard so state carries across steps. Tweaks tab → 'model' switches request-to-book (default) vs instant confirmation: header copy, step 5 CTA and 'pay today' line change. Pick 'United States' as nationality on step 4 to see the OFAC gate block the Continue button.

mobile_title_d.text: Customer · Mobile · Support, sign-in, legal, errors

mobile_note1.text: Mobile homepage · the dashed line marks the first viewport (844 px); the bottom bar is drawn there because it is fixed in the real app. Search collapses to one field plus two chips that open bottom sheets. Primary CTAs sit in the thumb zone; the cookie consent (DS sheet 04) overlays on first visit.

web_note1.text: Homepage · direction proof for the design system. Tweaks tab: 'primary' swaps the CTA colour (teal / terracotta / green) across the page. Reviews are sample copy; photos are tinted placeholders carrying their alt text. Links become live when the package and destination screens land in section 2.

ds_note1.text: Source of truth: the team's Isla Abierta DS v1.0 (UI_UX doc 16). One deliberate deviation: neutrals are warmed (cream ground, stone borders) to match the 'warm cream / warm greys' brief. Brand hues, semantics, type and spacing are kept exactly.

ds_note2.text: A11y notes · Actions & forms: focus ring 2px teal #0B4F6C offset 2px on every control on light surfaces (ochre #F2B134 on the dark sidebar; corrected 6 Oct after a 1.78:1 contrast measurement); disabled buttons keep their label and get aria-disabled when they must stay focusable; counters announce the new value via aria-live; the currency menu is a listbox (Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger); insurance tiers are a radiogroup, never clickable divs.

admin_note_login.text: Admin shell for section 3: 1440-wide pages, same tokens as the customer site (teal, terracotta, ochre, cream), 44 px targets, status vocabulary from DS sheet 03. Tweaks tab on A-Login: "role" switches the signed-in card between Super Admin, Operations Admin and Administrative Support.

admin_note_dash.text: Dashboard · the red strip carries the audio cue (mute is logged, never silences a NEW red alert). Dispatch matrix: one column per service, timer bar amber at 75 %, red at 100 % or on decline. Click "Re-dispatch" on the VX-3PA8ZT row to open the one-click fallback menu: nearby qualified, verified workers only; "Offer" restarts a 2 h timer for that worker.

admin_note_disr.text: Disruption case · scenario chips swap the playbook, options and compensation rule (crisis framework §1–2). Severity radios change the escalation path, banner level and whether emergency contacts are notified. "Mark safe" and "Send options" write to the case log at the bottom.

admin_note_pkg.text: Packages · the bulk import (spec §4.7) is a 4-step stepper at the bottom: upload → column mapping with confidence → validation grid that flags missing prices, foreign currency and unknown suppliers → commit (reversible 24 h). Click "Use sample" to walk through it.

admin_note_sup.text: Suppliers · select a row to load the inspector. Yoel Martínez shows the expiry pause (licence 2 Nov → auto-dispatch paused since 3 Oct, manual assignment still allowed with a note). Yunier Blanco shows PENDING_AUDIT with approve/reject. Casas carry the backup-power fields that feed the disruption console.

admin_title_c.text: Admin · Money, content, reports, settings & assistant

admin_note_rep.text: Reports · two figures are deliberate placeholders: the Res. 193/2026 reinvestment exemption threshold and the legal ecotourism-ratio threshold (both wait for the MFP implementing rules). The MINTUR licence number stays [MINTUR-2026-XXXX] everywhere until issued.

apps_note_w.text: Worker app (spec §5.2) · Spanish UI because guides, drivers and hosts are Cuban; the desk sees translations. Offline-first: every accept, decline and calendar change is queued and synced later (sync_queue). Workers only ever see traveler first names, languages and local emergency numbers, never billing data (§8.2). Tweaks on W-Login: credential status banner.

apps_title_b.text: Ops Lite · admin triage on the phone (EN)

apps_note_al.text: Ops Lite (spec §5.4) · triage only: re-dispatch, call, acknowledge, approve, reply. Everything else stays on the desk. AL-Alerts: tap the red card, "Re-dispatch" shows the fallback guides, "Offer" restarts the timer. AL-Pipeline: tap a state to expand its bookings. AL-Inbox: worker threads translate inline; replies are logged as "(mobile)".

docs_note.text: Generated documents · fixed A4 pages (794×1123) so footers with the MINTUR licence repeat on every sheet; Export PDF gives one page per artboard. Voucher and invoice in the traveler language, work order and the MINTUR summary in Spanish. Addresses, embassy and clinic numbers, tax ID and licence are placeholders in [brackets] until real values exist. QR squares stand for the live-document link.

comms_note.text: Emails at 600 px (EN shown; ES and FR render from the same template, the OFAC reminder is shown in Spanish because Luis prefers it). Subject, preheader, sender and attachments sit in the grey strip above each email. SMS, push and the morning check-in live on the phone board at the end. Every email carries the MINTUR licence and the 24/7 line; transactional ones have no unsubscribe.

handoff_note.text: Diagrams are built from separate cards and arrows (every box and arrow drags alone). Colours: teal = system state, green = success path, amber = waiting, red = escalation. The traceability sheet maps every spec section to the artboards that cover it and names what is still a placeholder.

brand_title.text: Brand · Vereda Expeditions · identity, stationery, cards, email

brand_note_nfc.text: NFC card · write the URL vereda.travel/c/<handle> as an NDEF URI record on an NTAG213 card (144 bytes is plenty); iPhone XS+ and Android read it on tap with no app. The paper card’s QR opens the same handle on the platform (?via=). Save contact serves brand/cards/<handle>.vcf (FN, ORG, TITLE, TEL cell + 24/7 line, EMAIL, URL, ADR, NOTE licence). Page is static, ~20 KB, no cookies; event dcard_opened{via} on T-Events.
